einzeiler: Fitness, crime operations, SNL monologues, and political controversies examined.
kurzfassung: The hosts discuss popular meat snack trends, police crackdown operations in St. Louis, and mugshot internet culture. They debate Shane Gillis's SNL gym monologue and analyze a study regarding college students faking political views. Additional segments cover the cancellation of the Fort Hood shooter's live-streamed execution, White House press briefing controversies, citizenship probes, and viral acts of kindness.
